nina: Quick sync: we need a compact profile contract for fp8/int8 rollouts. Runtime perf is critical.

omar: Agreed. Minimal manifest: name, hash, expected_quality_delta, ops_blacklist[], calibration_hash, release_tag. Flat only.

sasha: Runtime preflight: verify signature/hash, check compat bitmap -> instant accept or fallback to fp16. No retries.

ops-bot: Canaries: shadow -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with LL delta and latency thresholds.

nina: Draft RFC + runbook next.
